field.name: blobId
field.description: The content blob of content over resource-facade dbresource-blob-threshold bytes, in place of fileData

field.name: fileSize
field.description: The bytes of the content (fileData, or the content blob), written with each write so a folder list need not read the files; a row written before this field is sized from its data until its next write (or migrate#DbResourceBlobs).

field.name: versionNote
field.description: The note written with the current version (an upload's version note); its DbResourceFileHistory row keeps it too, so it stays with the version when a later write replaces it.

field.name: blobId
field.description: The content blob of a past version kept as one

field.name: versionNote
field.description: The note written with this version

field.name: repositoryKind
field.description: remote (a read-only mirror of remoteUrl, kept by fetch), local (a bare repository at localPath that commits are written to), or db (the objects and refs in GitObject and GitRef)

field.name: remoteUrl
field.description: For remote: the HTTPS (or file, or ssh through the system ssh binary) URL fetched from. For local and db: where import#GitRepository reads from when no source is given.

field.name: branch
field.description: The branch locations read and write; main when empty

field.name: localPath
field.description: The bare repository directory for remote and local kinds, relative to the runtime directory unless absolute; runtime/git/repositoryId when empty

field.name: accessToken
field.description: HTTPS password or token for fetch

field.name: fetchIntervalMinutes
field.description: For remote: fetch#AllGitRepositories fetches this repository when this long has passed since the last fetch; never when empty

field.name: headCommitId
field.description: The branch head after the last write, push or fetch

field.name: lastUpdateDate
field.description: When a write, push or fetch last changed a ref

field.name: objectCount
field.description: For db: GitObject rows after the last gc#GitRepositories

field.name: storedBytes
field.description: For db: bytes of objectData after the last gc#GitRepositories

field.name: gcLeaseOwner
field.description: The run of gc#GitRepositories that holds this repository (the only one that rewrites its objects) until gcLeaseUntil

field.name: archivedDate
field.description: When the repository was archived (archive#GitRepository): read only, pushes, ref writes, merges and writes refused, left out of find#GitRepositories unless asked

field.name: defaultMergeMethodEnumId
field.description: How a merge request merges by default: GmmMerge (a merge commit, the default when empty) or GmmSquash

entity.description: A git object of a db kind repository, keyed by its SHA-1 hex id, stored as storage says. lastUpdatedStamp is when it was written or last referenced again: gc#GitRepositories deletes only an unreachable object not touched since its cutoff.

field.name: objectType
field.description: commit, tree, blob, or tag

field.name: objectSize
field.description: The size of the content

field.name: storage
field.description: What objectData holds: zlib (the zlib stream of the content, as in a pack), delta (the zlib stream of git delta instructions that make the content from the object deltaBaseId), or empty (the content itself, as rows written before these were); or blob, for an object over git-server db-large-object bytes: the content is the ContentBlob blobId

field.name: deltaDepth
field.description: Deltas from the object to a whole one

field.name: deltaSize
field.description: The size of the delta instructions

field.name: storedBytes
field.description: The size of objectData

field.name: refName
field.description: refs/heads/branch

entity.description: One change to the refs of a repository: a push (each one, accepted or not, so this is the push log), a fetch of a mirror, an import, or (when a gitECA rule listens for them) a write through git://. The gitECA rules of its post events (ref-update, commit, tag, post-receive) run from it after the change, so a restart does not lose them (ecaStatus pending, then running, done or failed).

field.name: source
field.description: push, fetch, import or write

field.name: transport
field.description: http, ssh or internal

field.name: userId
field.description: Who pushed or wrote; empty for a fetch run by a job

field.name: priorTips
field.description: The ids every ref pointed to before the change, separated by spaces: the commits new to the repository are those the new refs reach and these do not

field.name: ecaStatus
field.description: recording (the refs are being changed), pending, running, done, failed, or none (nothing changed)

field.name: changeType
field.description: create, update (a fast-forward), force or delete

field.name: result
field.description: ok, pending while it is made, or why it was refused

entity.description: A check of a commit posted by outside CI (create#GitCommitStatus, or POST /rest/s1/moqui/git/{repositoryId}/commits/{commitId}/statuses in GitHub's status shape): the latest of a context is its state.

field.name: context
field.description: What checked it (ci/build); default when empty

field.name: state
field.description: pending, success, failure or error

field.name: targetUrl
field.description: The run, on the CI server

entity.description: An outside URL called on a repository's events (push, tag, merge_request) with a JSON body signed by HMAC-SHA256 of the secret (X-Hub-Signature-256): each delivery a SystemMessage of type GitWebhook, retried by retry#GitWebhookDeliveries, its attempts the delivery log.

field.name: url
field.description: http or https; an internal address is refused

field.name: events
field.description: Comma separated: push, tag, merge_request; all when empty

field.name: lastDeliveryStatus
field.description: The HTTP status of the last attempt, or error

entity.description: A protected branch (or tag) of a repository, enforced by the git server before a pushed ref moves and by the ref and merge services: a pattern that starts with refs/ is matched against the full ref name, any other against a branch's name, * any run of characters. Writes through git:// by users with the update right pass and are logged.

field.name: requireMergeRequest
field.description: Changes only through a merge request, except for members of pushUserGroupId

field.name: dismissStaleApprovals
field.description: A new head of the source sets its approvals back to requested

field.name: requiredStatusContexts
field.description: Comma separated commit status contexts that must be success on the head before a merge

field.name: allowedMergeMethods
field.description: Comma separated GitMergeMethod enumIds; any when empty

field.name: pushUserGroupId
field.description: Only members of this group may push directly

entity.description: A request to merge a source branch into a target branch of one repository, reviewed by the users of GitMergeRequestReviewer (org.moqui.impl.GitReviewServices). headCommitId and mergeability are kept by refresh#MergeRequests on every ref update.

field.name: mergeRequestNum
field.description: Per repository from 1: !num

field.name: sourceRef
field.description: The source branch name

field.name: targetRef
field.description: The target branch name

field.name: headCommitId
field.description: The source's head when last refreshed

field.name: baseCommitId
field.description: The merge base of the source and the target

field.name: conflictPaths
field.description: One path per line

field.name: mergeMethodEnumId
field.description: The method it merges by: the repository's default when empty

entity.description: A reviewer of a merge request and their latest review, at the head it was given on.

field.name: reviewNote
field.description: The summary of the latest review

entity.description: A Git LFS object of a repository, its content the ContentBlob of the same SHA-256. A repository has an object only once it was uploaded to it: the same content in another repository is stored once, and knowing its oid does not reach it.

field.name: oid
field.description: The SHA-256 of the content, the oid of the LFS pointer in the repository

entity.description: A file of a repository locked with git lfs lock, so others do not change it meanwhile.

field.name: blobId
field.description: The SHA-256 of the content, lowercase hex

field.name: storageKind
field.description: db: ContentBlobChunk rows

field.name: storageKey
field.description: The chunks' storageKey: the upload's

field.name: chunkSize
field.description: The size of each chunk but the last

entity.description: A blob being written: its chunks are under storageKey until the ContentBlob row is made. One whose lastActivityDate is a day old is abandoned, and gc#ContentBlobs deletes its chunks.

A root location with an owner, members and a quota. The storage is the root's scheme: a personal or folder drive on the database tree (dbresource://, under the moqui.drive.root preference, dbresource://drive by default), a version-controlled drive or a mirror on git://repositoryId/ over the GitRepository of its kind (db, local; remote for a mirror). A records drive is a view over record attachment folders, mapped by its ResourceDriveRecordFolder rows.

field.name: driveKindEnumId
field.description: RdkPersonal, RdkShared, RdkMirror or RdkRecords

field.name: rootLocation
field.description: The drive's top folder: dbresource://drive/..., or git://repositoryId/ (with an optional folder)

field.name: repositoryId
field.description: The GitRepository of a git:// drive

field.name: quotaBytes
field.description: The most bytes the drive may hold; no limit when empty

field.name: archivedDate
field.description: An archived drive is read only and leaves the user's list

field.name: indexedVersionName
field.description: For a mirror: the commit its search documents were last brought to (FileServices.index#MirrorDrives)

entity.description: Who may open a drive besides its owner: a user or a user group, with RdpView, RdpEdit or RdpManage, from fromDate until thruDate.

A records drive's map from a top folder to the record entity whose attachments it holds (each folder below it named by a record id), seeded by the application that writes those folders (the framework stays out of their layout): FileServices.list#Folder shows the mapped folders at the drive's top with their labels, and the record folders below as records.

field.name: folderPath
field.description: Relative to the drive's root, for example party or CommunicationEvent or asset/*/maintenance (a * segment is a record id of the entity before it)

field.name: idField
field.description: The record's id field, for a link to the record

entity.description: A file or folder of a drive shared with a user, a user group, a party, or by link. A link's token is random and kept only as its hash (linkTokenHash); its password only as passwordHash. A share is current until its expireDate, revokedDate, or (for an incoming share) declinedDate.

field.name: path
field.description: Relative to the drive's root; empty is the whole drive

field.name: permissionEnumId
field.description: RspView, RspEdit or RspUpload (a file drop)

entity.description: A tag for files: a user's own (ownerUserId), or one for everyone when ownerUserId is empty

A file or folder moved to a drive's trash. On the database tree it moved, with its history, into the drive's hidden trash folder (trashLocation); on a git:// drive it was deleted in one commit, and versionName is the commit before it, which restore writes back from.

field.name: path
field.description: Where it was, relative to the drive's root

entity.description: A file a user opened or changed lately, for FileServices.find#Recent

Who saved each version of a page (versionName) and the page's moves (oldPagePath, with oldWikiSpaceId when it came from another space). The versions themselves are the page file's: history rows on the database tree, commits on git. A move that replayed the history into other storage renames versionName to the copy's.

field.name: oldWikiSpaceId
field.description: For a move from another space, the space it came from

field.name: versionNote
field.description: The note given with the save or move (the version's own note is kept with the version too: the commit message, or DbResourceFile.versionNote)

entity.description: A link in a page's text to another wiki page, indexed by update#WikiPage from the page's markdown (or HTML) each time its text is written: the target as written (linkTarget), the space and path it names (toWikiSpaceId, toPagePath; a relative path from the page's own place), and toWikiPageId when a page is there by that path or a WikiPageAlias (a moved page leaves an alias at its old path, so a link to it keeps working). A link to a page not made yet has no toWikiPageId until that page is made. Read by get#WikiPageBacklinks and get#WikiPageLinks.

field.name: linkTarget
field.description: The target as written in the text

entity.description: A document several people edit at once (m-coedit, org.moqui.impl.CollabServices; docs/Revision-Management.md, Co-editing): the Yjs state of its editors (stateData, the full update in Yjs v1 encoding, kept current a second or two after an edit and merged when several servers write it), the markdown it renders to (snapshotText), and what it was last saved as. documentKey names the record, such as WikiPage:100023. The record's own text (the wiki page) is written only as a version: when the user saves, after a while without edits on database files, and when the last editor closes it. editorUserIds are the users whose changes are not in a version yet.

field.name: baseTextHash
field.description: The SHA-256 of the record's text the state was made from or last saved as; a text that no longer has it was changed outside co-editing

entity.description: A request that a user review a version of a page before it is published, and the decision: requested, then approved (which publishes the version unless told not to), changes requested (with a note back) or cancelled. One row per reviewer; with no reviewerUserId any user who may update the page may decide it. The reviewer is notified on topic WikiPageReview, an approval the tray decides (approve#WikiPageReview, refuse#WikiPageReview); the requester on WikiPageReviewDecision. Services: org.moqui.impl.WikiServices request#WikiPageReview, decide#WikiPageReview, cancel#WikiPageReview, find#WikiPageReviews.

field.name: versionName
field.description: The version to review: a version name or a commit id

field.name: baseVersionName
field.description: The version published when the review was asked, the left side of its compare; empty for a page never published

field.name: note
field.description: The requester's note

field.name: decisionNote
field.description: The reviewer's note with the decision: the changes asked for

field.name: notificationMessageId
field.description: The reviewer's notification, marked viewed by the decision

entity.description: Each record represents a single blog article, grouped as needed by categories (WikiBlogCategory)

field.name: sentDate
field.description: The date/time a blog post within a category was sent by email or other means.
